title: 组合总和 III
summary: 从一到九中选出 k 个不同数字，使它们的和等于 n，返回所有组合。
insight: 按递增顺序选择数字消除重复排列，同时根据剩余数量和目标值剪枝。
pitfalls: 每个数字最多使用一次
组合内数字按递增顺序生成

solutions.title: 有界递增回溯
solutions.idea: 枚举下一个更大的数字，路径长度或剩余和不可能时停止。
steps: 路径长为 k 时检查 remaining 是否为零
value 大于 remaining 时提前结束，递归后回溯

code.java: class Solution { public List<List<Integer>> combinationSum3(int k,int n){List<List<Integer>> answer=new ArrayList<>();dfs(1,k,n,new ArrayList<>(),answer);return answer;}private void dfs(int start,int k,int remaining,List<Integer> path,List<List<Integer>> answer){if(path.size()==k){if(remaining==0)answer.add(new ArrayList<>(path));return;}for(int value=start;value<=9&&value<=remaining;value++){path.add(value);dfs(value+1,k,remaining-value,path,answer);path.remove(path.size()-1);}} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun combinationSum3(k:Int,n:Int):List<List<Int>>{val answer=mutableListOf<List<Int>>();val path=mutableListOf<Int>();fun dfs(start:Int,remaining:Int){if(path.size==k){if(remaining==0)answer.add(path.toList());return};for(value in start..9){if(value>remaining)break;path.add(value);dfs(value+1,remaining-value);path.removeAt(path.lastIndex)}};dfs(1,n);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { void dfs(int start,int k,int remaining,vector<int>& path,vector<vector<int>>& answer){if((int)path.size()==k){if(remaining==0)answer.push_back(path);return;}for(int value=start;value<=9&&value<=remaining;++value){path.push_back(value);dfs(value+1,k,remaining-value,path,answer);path.pop_back();}}public:vector<vector<int>> combinationSum3(int k,int n){vector<vector<int>> answer;vector<int> path;dfs(1,k,n,path,answer);return answer;} };
